_comment: Walls and siege (PLAN.md M5 step 10). The wall (building `wall`, plot `w`) rises in levels through tiers of sturdier material (each tier's `toughness` multiplies its integrity); while it stands it toughens the garrison and must be battered down: its integrity is `integrityPerLevel` per level. Wall slots (plots t0-t4) open at the wall levels in `slotsAt` and hold the towers (kind `tower` in buildings.json); their effects are per level. The walls hold `manning.menPerLevel` men a level, archers first; archers on them shoot `archerAttackPerLevel` harder a wall level. Escalade: while the walls stand, the horde's fighters (not archers) strike at `escalade.meleeHeld` of their attack, except the share carried over the walls by climbing engines (`escalade` men a round each, in enemies.json); a horde building climbers builds enough to carry `climbShare` of its fighters. The ditch (shown as the moat, dry until level `waterAt`) cuts battering, slows engine building and keeps climbers off by its per-level shares. A breach knocks the wall down `breachLevelsLost` levels. Siege: every enemy unit batters walls with `siege` from enemies.json, or `unitSiegeShare` of its attack when it has none. A horde that couldn't breach within `breachRounds` rounds builds engines (its front's `engine`) on site first, taking `setupHours` x its front's `siegeCraft` x the engine's `setupFactor` (a front with siegeCraft 0 builds none).
